name: count
algorithm: Count the bytes equal to b in a buffer of 4-bit values (the top four bits of a multiplicative hash of the index), reps counts with b = mix(st) & 15; the checksum is total * 31 + count over the counts, wrapping (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: no integer arithmetic to wrap in the kernel: the checksum already wraps

skip.mk: std.simd dispatches at run time (simd.Cpu()), so on an avx2 machine the Mk column runs its 32-lane form; this fixed-v2 variant would compare it with 16-byte vectors. Mk is compared in the v3 variants (status/std-simd.md, request R-3)

std.simd dispatches at run time (simd.Cpu()), so on an avx2 machine the Mk column runs its 32-lane form; this fixed-v2 variant would compare it with 16-byte vectors. Mk is compared in the v3 variants (status/std-simd.md, request R-3)

std.simd dispatches at run time (simd.Cpu()), so on an avx2 machine the Mk column runs its 32-lane form; this fixed-v2 variant would compare it with 16-byte vectors. Mk is compared in the v3 variants (status/std-simd.md, request R-3)

no_counts: B24 does not apply as a count of operations: the work per count is fixed by the size, and the checksum folds every count in order
notes: GB/s counts size * reps bytes; each count reads the whole buffer. The fill and its first-touch page faults are timed by each variant's baseline (reps 0) and subtracted (BS-3). The c, rust, zig and go buffers start on a 64-byte boundary (BS-4); the mk column reads an arena slice whose alignment Mk code cannot set without std.raw (BS-4's labelled exception, tests/bench/README.md).

c: <immintrin.h>, compare masks subtracted from four byte counters, _mm*_sad_epu8 every 255 steps, _mm_popcnt_u32 of the movemask for single vectors (std.simd.Count's method), chosen by __AVX2__. rust: the same with std::arch, every load from a checked slice (BS-2), count_ones of the movemask. zig: @Vector compares selected to 1 into u8 counters, widened and reduced every 255 steps, @popCount for single vectors (rust and zig added in std-simd session 2). go: bytes.Count, assembly-backed in Go's runtime with its own CPU check, labelled. mk: std.simd.Count.

Checksums from the go column (go run testdata/count.go at each size, 2026-11-07), checked by tools/bench verify in every written column. The repetitions were set so the c cell ran about 1 s at L1 and L3 in a single run on a shared machine (2026-11-07).
Written by the std-simd lane (status/std-simd.md, session 1). Nothing here is published: bench-final publishes (status/bench.md).
